justification: SELINA: Josh Allen decided Buffalo deserved a vacation the same week I need a QB, which I read as disloyalty, so he's benched and Bryce Young — 18.58 projected, a man who shows up — is in. I also upgraded the flex, because Devaughn Vele is a name nobody at the owners' meeting has ever said out loud and DK Metcalf is a name people lean forward for; ten-point-four projected is just the bonus. Everything else stayed because it was already correct, which I take full credit for. GARY: (for the record, I flagged the Allen bye Tuesday and she said "fine, your call, don't make it weird" — Bryce Young over Stafford is the better number, 18.58 to 17.47, and the Metcalf-for-Vele swap is clean value, no drama required on my end this week, I promise.) Kelce and Waddle are Questionable but the best healthy names we've got at those slots, so they stay.
